evals.expected_output: Asks whether to backfill documents, notes, or both, and whether to scope to this project or everything on the server, then runs research_list_fetched and/or research_notes_search and calls graph_structural_sync.py per item, reporting counts.
expectations: Asks the Step 1 scoping question before doing anything, since $ARGUMENTS gives no scope
Never asks the user to approve an individual upsert/link write - this skill's writes are purely mechanical
Calls shared/scripts/graph_structural_sync.py via Bash rather than reimplementing the upsert/link logic inline
Reports a count of documents linked, notes linked, and how many edges were newly created vs already present

evals.prompt: My notes on arxiv 2401.12345 aren't showing up when I explore the graph.
evals.expected_output: Scopes the backfill to that one paper's notes, calls research_notes_search filtered to that identifier, then graph_structural_sync.py link for each matching note, and reports which were newly created vs already existed.
expectations: Scopes to arxiv 2401.12345 specifically rather than running a full backfill
Uses research_notes_search with provider=arxiv and canonical_identifier=2401.12345
Calls graph_structural_sync.py link with --to-ref-id arxiv:2401.12345 for every matching note
Does not claim notes were linked if the script's own 'created' field says they already existed

evals.prompt: Link everything I've fetched into the graph, this project only.
evals.expected_output: Interprets 'fetched' as documents, calls research_list_fetched, upserts a Pointer per distinct (provider, identifier), and asks (rather than assumes) whether notes should also be included since the user only mentioned documents.
expectations: Scopes document enumeration to research_list_fetched grouped by (provider, identifier), not a raw flat list
Asks whether notes should also be backfilled, since the user's phrasing ('everything I've fetched') is ambiguous about notes
Applies project scoping via project_tag.py rather than backfilling every project's documents
Reports the final count of documents linked
